task_description: Build SentinelArc - a production-grade real-time safety and moderation layer for AI companion apps. Screens conversations for self-harm signals, age-inappropriate content, and compliance red flags. Escalates to crisis resources, blocks content when thresholds trip, and produces regulator-grade audit trails. Full SaaS with auth, ingestion API, scoring pipeline, crisis routing, reviewer dashboard, compliance export, billing, and client dashboard.

verification.summary: All 273 tests pass across 20 test suites. Lint clean. TypeCheck clean. Build succeeds. Property-based tests confirm crisis routing invariants. Latency tests confirm sub-50ms crisis path. Audit log immutability tests confirm tamper detection.
